notes: Qal ("rebel", Zeph.3.1, מֹרְאָה, paired with "defiled" describing the corrupt city) was not requested, but is attested and included per the standing rule of always including attested-but-unrequested stems. Because qal precedes hiphil in STEM_ORDER, it -- not the requested hiphil "flap" -- becomes the root-level primary gloss; hiphil "flap" (Job.39.18, the ostrich flapping her wings) is now a stem_glosses entry instead.
